prompts.approach: Fully positive, static-scene method: lock the camera with Google's own words, write the ambulance as a parked landmark, and give all the background motion to one named stream of traffic (left to right). The sound is stated positively, not as a negative.
prompts.prompt: Static, locked-off shot. The man stands still holding the microphone. Behind him, the yellow ambulance stays parked at the junction, blue lights flashing. A line of dark cars slides past behind it, left to right. Rain falls. Only rain and tyre sounds. Thanks.

prompts.approach: Built on the bare prompt that already went through. Timestamped halves pin the ambulance's end state ('still in the same spot'), so the only reading is that it never leaves. The traffic runs the other way (right to left) to give a real alternative, and it keeps the proven 'No dialogue, no music' ending.
prompts.prompt: The camera does not move. The man holds still with the microphone. [00:00-00:04] Behind him, the yellow van waits, blue lights flashing, as dark cars pass right to left. [00:04-00:08] The van is still in the same spot. Rain falls. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.
